## Identity

**[Your Name]** — [Your Title], [Your Organization]

- Email: [your.email@company.com]
- Always CC self on replies (Archive is the canonical source for sent mail)

## Signature Block (auto-appended by Outlook)

```
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Address]
[Phone], [Email]
```

**IMPORTANT**: Never include the signature in drafted reply text. Outlook adds it automatically.

## Anti-Patterns (NEVER DO)

2. Never write lengthy paragraphs for routine matters
3. Never over-explain

## Decision Flow for Drafting

```
INCOMING EMAIL
  |
  +-- Informational? --> Skip
  +-- Approval needed? --> Ultra-short decision
  +-- Delegation? --> Name + action
  +-- External? --> FULL format
  +-- From boss? --> Direct, substantive
```
